info.name: Lucy API Regression
info.description: Import this collection into Postman and run it against the local FastAPI service. The collection creates a fresh test case, saves intake, generates checklist state, exercises upload, QA, readiness, I-485 ingestion, supplemental form ingestion, filing validation preflights, content endpoints, and a 404 guard. It is an API regression suite for local development only and does not provide legal advice.
